budget_items.topic: Marshall Park capital plan funds already appropriated
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Prior town votes for the capital plan conceptual design, capital plan survey and schematics engineering totaled $259,000, of which $116,680 was spent, leaving $142,320.
budget_items.quote: there were $50,000 for the capital plan conceptual design, $25,000 for capital plan survey, and another town vote for $184,000 for schematics engineering, totaling $259,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Select Board had allocated ARPA funds to the project.
budget_items.quote: a. scheipers noted the select board had allocated $1 million in arpa funds.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: A Parc grant of $500,000 is available to the project.
budget_items.quote: a. scheipers indicated there is $500,000 in parc grant.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Available funds were stated as $1,642,320 less $5000.
budget_items.quote: a. scheipers stated available found to be $1,642,320 less $5000.

budget_items.topic: Marshall Park OPM and design firm obligations
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Commission has obligations for owner's project management of not more than $250,000 and for the design firm RDLA of not more than $143,000 for phase 1.
budget_items.quote: the commission has obligations for the opm (owner's project management) for not more than $250,000 and for the design firm rdla for not more than $143,000 for phase 1.

budget_items.topic: Marshall Park phase 1 construction funds remaining
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The remaining funds for construction of phase 1 were stated as $1,244,320.
budget_items.quote: a. scheipers stated the remaining funds for the construction of phase 1 is $1,244,320.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The most recent cost estimate was stated as $1,600,000, which exceeded the funds available; the prior estimate was from January 2024.
budget_items.quote: a. scheipers stated the cost estimate received was $1,600,000.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Interim Town Manager said the Commission cannot ask for more than the previously asked for $5.2 million.
